descriptionEN: The Asian Association for Agricultural Engineering (AAAE), together with PERTETA – the Indonesian Society of Agricultural Engineering – convenes researchers, engineers and practitioners from across Asia and beyond to advance farming systems that hold their ground as the climate shifts. Peer-reviewed papers are published in the International Agricultural Engineering Journal (IAEJ, ISSN 0858-2114), Scopus indexed. TSAE members register at the member-society rate.
